raw_segments.text: Medea, surely I have my thoughts and not a few have held me strange.
To me it seameth when a crafty tongue is given to evil men teas like to wreck, not help them.
Their own brain tempts them with lies to dare and dare again till no man hath enough of
subtlety, as thou be not so seeming fair to me nor deft of speech.
One word will make thee fall, wert thou not false, twas thine to tell me all, and charge
me help thy marriage path as I did love thee, not befool me with a lie.
